row_granularity: A policy-period entry in the summary table or an individual claim in the detail loss tables
notes: The document contains multiple report sections and policy blocks. Page 1 has a summary table with one row per coverage/policy period, including rows marked "No Claims". Detail loss pages use a repeating header with Claimant, Adj Off, FP, Claim Number, Accident Date, Notice Date, Close Date, O/C, and financial columns grouped under Total, Claim, Medical, and Expense. Detailed policy numbers are displayed in the document header rather than repeated in a dedicated table column. Subtotal rows are labeled "Subtotals for Policy Number" and grand-total rows are labeled "Report Grand Totals".
